name: Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic
description: A Philadelphia veterinary clinic offering wellness exams, vaccinations, and general care for dogs and cats.

hero.headline: Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic
hero.sub: Wellness exams, vaccinations, and everyday care for the pets that count on you.

items: Wellness exams and vaccinations for dogs and cats
Diagnosis and treatment for everyday illness and injury
Guidance on nutrition, parasite prevention, and long-term care
Preventive-first approach to catch issues early
Calm, patient handling for anxious animals
Straightforward explanations before any treatment begins

story.heading: About
paragraphs: Dutton Road Veterinary Clinic treats pets the way owners want them treated -- carefully, and with a clear explanation of what is actually needed.
The clinic focuses on wellness and prevention, so small issues get caught before they turn into emergencies.

items: Book a wellness visit and get a clear plan before any procedure.
No pressure toward add-on services -- recommendations are explained, not upsold.
A calm exam room built to keep nervous pets (and owners) at ease.

feature.heading: Preventive care, explained simply
feature.text: Regular wellness exams catch small problems before they become expensive emergencies -- and they are far less stressful for your pet.

spotlight.heading: Vaccinations and everyday medicine
spotlight.text: From core vaccinations to treating a limp or an upset stomach, care is scoped to what your pet actually needs.
